title: Clinical Professor of Law
bio: Rachel A. Viscomi is a Clinical Professor at Harvard Law School and the Director of the Harvard Negotiation and Mediation Clinical Program (HNMCP). She runs the Harvard Dispute Systems Design Clinic, training students to become problem-solving lawyers, while supporting clients to rethink the ways they manage conflict within their organizations.
